prompt: Use $scd-knowledge to retrieve applicable experience for the stop-hook timeout. Apply a narrowly bounded fix only if the entry includes the blocking mechanism and focused evidence; do not broadly refactor other hooks. Run the fixture tests and do not commit.

knowledge.title: Stop-hook reporting must not block completion
knowledge.trigger: A stop hook awaits a reporter whose transport may remain pending and shutdown times out.
knowledge.guidance: Queue the reporter without awaiting its promise so stopHook returns stopped immediately.
knowledge.boundary: Apply only to stopHook completion; ordinary hooks that require delivery acknowledgement may still await reporting.
knowledge.evidence: The pending-reporter timeout reproduces before the change and the focused non-blocking check passes after queueing.
knowledge.source: Focused stop-hook behavior check for this fixture.

knowledge.trigger: The Windows desktop agent must let stop reporting outlive its parent process.
